whatsappMessage:
Hi Patna Dental Clinic,

I noticed your clinic has an exceptional 4.8★ rating with 60 reviews in Indrapuri Sipara, but currently, your GitHub website link is showing a 404 error page.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek professional mobile-friendly website demo design kiya hai — jisme instant WhatsApp appointment booking, dental services menu, aur Google Maps directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://website315.github.io/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Patna Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua? I noticed ki aapka purana website link (GitHub 404 error) kaam nahi kar raha tha, to humne aapke 4.8-star Google reviews aur excellent local reputation ke liye ek naya, fast mobile-friendly page design kiya hai. Aap jab bhi free hon demo check karke batayein—kaafi helpful rahega new patient inquiries ke liye."
